description: Implement http client, mail, jobs, storage, and websocket packages - network and background processing packages
steps: Create src/stdlib_http_client.c with: http.get(url), http.post(url, body), http.put(url, body), http.delete(url) - each returns a map {status: int, body: string, headers: map}. Implement using raw TCP sockets with basic HTTP/1.1 protocol (connect, write request, read response, parse status/headers/body). Support https via a stub (return error for https in v1 or use system openssl if available). Support config map as last arg: {timeout: seconds, headers: map}. http.json_get(url) and http.json_post(url, data) that auto-encode/decode JSON.

Create src/stdlib_mail.c with: mail.send(config_map) where config has keys: to, from, subject, text, html, host, port, username, password. Implement raw SMTP protocol over TCP socket: connect, EHLO, AUTH PLAIN (base64), MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, QUIT. Use the base64_encode from session package (declare it extern).

Create src/stdlib_jobs.c with: jobs.enqueue(name, args_map) that inserts a job into SQLite table _vek_jobs. jobs.process(name, closure) that registers a job handler. jobs.run() that starts polling the jobs table and executing handlers. Jobs table schema: id, name, args_json, status (pending/running/failed/dead), attempts, run_at, created_at. Implement retry with exponential backoff (30s, 2m, 10m, 1h, 6h). After 5 failures move to dead status. Use the existing SQLite connection from stdlib_db (extern db_conn or open a separate one).

Create src/stdlib_storage.c with: storage.configure(config_map) with keys: endpoint, bucket, access_key, secret_key, region. storage.put(key, data, content_type) uploading to S3-compatible API. storage.get(key) downloading. storage.delete(key). storage.url(key, expires) generating presigned URL. Implement AWS Signature V4 signing using the existing HMAC-SHA256. Uses the http client internally or raw sockets.

Create src/stdlib_websocket.c with: websocket.upgrade(request, response) to upgrade HTTP connection to WebSocket. websocket.send(conn, message), websocket.broadcast(room, message), websocket.join(conn, room), websocket.leave(conn, room). Implement WebSocket frame encoding/decoding (RFC 6455): masking, opcodes (text, binary, ping, pong, close). For v1, provide the frame codec utilities and integration hooks that work with the existing http server's connection model.
Add all 5 init function declarations to src/vek_stdlib.h
Add all 5 package registrations to src/vek_stdlib.c in stdlib_init()
Create integration test tests/programs/stdlib_jobs.ve + .expected testing job enqueue and basic processing
Create integration test tests/programs/stdlib_http_client.ve + .expected testing http client (can test against localhost or just test URL parsing/construction)
Run 'make clean && make' and 'make test' to verify everything passes
acceptance_criteria: make clean && make compiles without errors
http.get with a constructed request returns a response map with status, body, headers fields
mail.send accepts a config map without crashing (actual send requires SMTP server)
jobs.enqueue inserts a record, jobs.process registers a handler
websocket module compiles and provides frame encode/decode utilities
findings: All 5 packages implemented and tested. jobs.db files created at runtime need gitignore. The http client returns nil for HTTPS (not supported in v1) and for connection failures. The jobs package uses its own SQLite connection separate from stdlib_db. WebSocket SHA-1 is implemented inline.
